name: VS Code
paste_label: Paste this into Copilot Chat (Agent mode) in VS Code
steps_title: Copilot sets it up for you.

register.p: This writes the user-level mcp.json, whose top-level key is servers. If {{SERVER}} is already in that file (command MCP: Open User Configuration), ask the user before replacing it.

confirm.p: Ask the user to run MCP: List Servers from the Command Palette and start {{SERVER}} if it isn't running. New chats in Agent mode then have its tools.
